# Original offline speech fixtures

Original test sentences synthesized on the development Mac using the built-in Samantha, Meijia and Good News voices; converted to mono 16 kHz PCM. No third-party song or recording is used. These small test-only files let Windows and macOS run identical recognition checks without OS-specific speech synthesis commands. They are not bundled in MyCut.

- `original-en.wav`: Welcome to My Cut. Today we are editing a video. The sun is shining and the sky is blue.
- `original-zh.wav`: 今天我們要來剪輯影片。把每一句話變成字幕，讓故事更清楚。
- `original-lyrics.wav`: We walk into the morning light. We sing a song and feel all right.
